title: An offline wallet, on your phone
narration: Meet Tap C Peso, an offline wallet prototype using demo money.

title: Two phones. Two demo accounts.
narration: Tap Quick Demo Setup. Open Person One on the first phone, and Person Two on the second.

title: Your balance lives on your device
narration: Your dashboard shows the local balance. Add mock funds, then choose Send Offline.

title: Choose who. Choose how much. Approve.
narration: Enter the receiver's number and twenty five pesos. Confirm your wallet PIN, then approve with your fingerprint or device passcode.

title: Deliver the signed payment
narration: Funds are deducted once. The receiver scans your QR, or reads NFC from a compatible Android sender.

title: Received once. Credited immediately.
narration: The app checks the recipient and signature, then credits the receiver. Duplicate payments are rejected locally.

title: A local ledger you can review
narration: History starts as offline pending. Simulated sync verifies signatures. It does not contact a bank.

title: Offline demo. Clear limits.
narration: Tap C Peso: demo money only. Hardware testing required.
